requiredBehaviors.behavior: verify the current Suno model and capability state before giving model-dependent advice
requiredBehaviors.evidence: Phase 0 requires a fresh official Suno capability snapshot and blocks model-dependent production advice when model, duration, edit, or rights information may have changed.

requiredBehaviors.behavior: decompose reference tracks into musical craft dimensions instead of using them as exact-clone prompts
requiredBehaviors.evidence: Phase 2 explicitly decomposes references into tempo, groove, harmony, instrumentation, vocals, arrangement, dynamics, and mix characteristics and defines the output as a style-vector rather than an artist clone.

requiredBehaviors.behavior: preserve album identity while assigning each track its own musical role
requiredBehaviors.evidence: Track Intent Contract requires track function and neighboring-track differentiation, and Prompt Ready requires each album track to retain a recognizable individual function.

requiredBehaviors.behavior: return Title then Lyrics then Style in that order
requiredBehaviors.evidence: Phase 4 defines the canonical user handoff order as Title, Lyrics, Style, then Advanced controls only when relevant.

requiredBehaviors.behavior: put key target length and vocals or melody information inside the Style block
requiredBehaviors.evidence: Phase 4 states explicitly that key/mode, Target length, and Vocals / Melody belong in the Style block rather than a loose remainder field.

requiredBehaviors.behavior: use explicit structural repetition when it is idiomatic to the genre rather than adding a generic miscellaneous field
requiredBehaviors.evidence: Phase 3 permits explicitly written repetition for Dance, Trance, Hard-Trance, Makina, and Workout tracks when musically idiomatic; Phase 4 removes a Sonstiges/Misc catch-all field.

requiredBehaviors.behavior: generate or compare multiple purposeful candidates instead of automatically selecting take one
requiredBehaviors.evidence: Explore -> Select -> Refine calls for purposeful exploration variants, comparative selection, targeted refinement, and explicitly states that Take 1 is not the default winner.

requiredBehaviors.behavior: record the result and reusable learning in the project Second Brain
requiredBehaviors.evidence: Phase 9 requires project observations and reusable learnings to be written to the Suno Project Second Brain with evidence class and model-change revalidation rules.

forbiddenBehaviors.behavior: create a separate Sonstiges or Misc field for key length or vocal information
forbiddenBehaviors.evidence: The prompt contract explicitly forbids a separate Sonstiges/Misc field when the information belongs in Style or verified Advanced controls.

forbiddenBehaviors.behavior: ask Suno to exactly imitate a living artist
forbiddenBehaviors.evidence: Reference Decomposition explicitly prohibits direct requests to exactly imitate a living artist and requires abstracted craft characteristics instead.

forbiddenBehaviors.behavior: treat an old Suno duration limit as a timeless fact
forbiddenBehaviors.evidence: The capability gate says historical model limits are not current facts and model-family changes invalidate performance heuristics until revalidated.

forbiddenBehaviors.behavior: store audio binaries in the GitHub Second Brain just for convenience
forbiddenBehaviors.evidence: The Second-Brain Storage Boundary routes audio, stems, cover, and other non-text files to the documented external artifact store rather than a GitHub binary archive.
